Arvada Dental Center — six pages, six pastes

Click Copy, switch to the Webflow Designer, click the canvas, press Ctrl/Cmd + V. One page per button.

Paste into a scratch page first. The clipboard format is reverse-engineered from real Webflow captures, not a documented API.
Images will be broken until the 14 assets in assets.json are uploaded and mapped — expected, not a defect.

  • Each payload has a single root. A multi-root paste is what crashes the Designer — size is not the problem.
  • Every class ships with an empty style definition. The CSS lives in a scoped <style> embed inside each block, because this design is clamp()/calc(var())/svh throughout and Webflow's style panel cannot hold it.
  • Class names are namespaced per page, so nothing merges with the client's existing classes.
  • Each page includes its own nav and footer. Delete those two blocks if the target page already carries the client's.
